Player: Mara is a navigator with Navigation F · 2/5. She waits at the Harbor on Day 7 at noon, rested, with two rations. Lyra is beside her and they intend to cross the bay before dusk.

Narrator: Mara trusts Lyra. The bay can be crossed at low tide. Mara alone knows that the silver key opens the archive.

Player: Pack two rations for the crossing.
